Our clubs

Anyone can be X.

The X stands for everyone. Together, we create something greater than ourselves: a community built one rally at a time.

We opened our first club in Concord, California, so that anyone in the East Bay could play indoors, any hour, with people who love the game as much as they do. Next up: Dallas–Fort Worth and Brooklyn.

9

Climate-controlled courts

Indoor courts with outdoor-style surfaces and professional nets. No wind, no rain, no waiting for daylight.

24/7

Member access

Early bird or night owl, members get in whenever they want to play.

All

Skill levels

Free Pickleball 101 for first-timers, DUPR-rated coaches for everyone else, and dedicated games for beginners and seniors.

Where we're headed

Five clubs are planned for Dallas–Fort Worth, starting with Lewisville, Coppell and Carrollton, plus a club in Brooklyn. Members will have cross-club privileges as each one opens.

Pricing, renderings and opening dates for the new clubs, sent once. No spam.
